scope: Independent nonvisual source/CPU evidence review; no GPU/window execution or edits in owner worktree
decision: Scoped native-window input source and CPU evidence accepted at immutable88ad9d8892e81857deefb98929c32366c64d73c0; no remaining source findings in this first slice.

resolved_findings.issue: Resize published a new hit-test layout before a frame displayed it when no simulation tick was due.
resolved_findings.resolution: Resize now reserves a surface before CPU layout publication, refreshes/consumes that reservation in the same callback, and fences pointer delivery until presented. Failed reservation leaves old layout accepted.

resolved_findings.issue: A new click with unknown cursor position after resize could fall through to gameplay.
resolved_findings.resolution: Interactive layouts suppress unknown-position presses until a real cursor sample; HUD/no-UI path retains passthrough.

resolved_findings.issue: Temporary surface timeout cleared queued typing and later fabricated blur/resume cleared text focus without OS blur.
resolved_findings.resolution: Separate retained surface_retry preserves physical and text queues and accepted focus/preedit; resume from this cause does not inject Focus(false,true). Real focus loss/suspend/nonpresentable transitions reset receipt ownership.

resolved_findings.issue: Gamepad releases were still dropped while suspended for a preserved surface retry, leaving prior held controls latched.
resolved_findings.resolution: Shared accepts_delivery predicate admits native callbacks and gamepad poll through temporary waits, with an actual GamepadAdapter to InputRuntime held/release regression.

verified_contracts: Bounded UI event count and aggregate text bytes before owned text copy
Arc owner/layout generation/delivery epoch fencing with canonical hit logic
CancelPointer never activates a released widget and preserves text/preedit
Owned candidate state and pending receipts remain separate from accepted publication

No-UI event admission and tick path retain prior behavior

Queued text across surface deferral and actual blur controls
Gamepad held/released continuation through preserved surface deferral
limits: Native screen-space GPU consumer is still explicitly required before window UI can start.
Managed OS preedit/activation and composition-origin fencing remain a separate next slice.
